recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future work is only needed if generated/rendered profile pages regress and show XPath instead of the FHIRPath expressions present in source.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Observation issue raised against the DSTU2 vital-signs page requesting that profile invariant displays show FHIRPath expressions rather than XPath expressions; Jira resolution says it was auto-approved and apparently already fixed.
initial_application: No local git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-12917. A same-day Zulip thread records the reporter identifying the vital-signs XPath/FHIRPath display problem and Grahame Grieve saying FHIRPath, not XPath, should display and that he would fix it. Later commit 88a1f3d6bd60f7618ae140179b008ac5686e8a08 removed residual XPath values from vital-signs constraints.
additional_context: FHIR-12916 came from the same vital-signs invariant discussion and concerned the content of adjacent invariant expressions. Observation is active in source/fhir.ini and the Observation vital-signs ImplementationGuide references StructureDefinition/vitalsigns and child profiles, making the checked XML current build input. Confluence searches found no conflicting record.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because current source/observation/structuredefinition-profile-vitalsigns.xml uses ElementDefinition.expression FHIRPath values for the relevant invariants and a source search found zero XPath values in the vital-sign profile XML files.

related_jiras.note: Raised from the same Zulip discussion and concerns the correctness of the same vital-signs invariant expressions.
